panels.title: Total PO value by vendor (incl. GST)

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, sum(pi.qty * pi.rate * (1 + pi.gst_rate / 100.0)) AS total_value FROM pos p JOIN vendors v ON v.id = p.vendor_id JOIN po_items pi ON pi.po_id = p.id WHERE p.po_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY total_value DESC

panels.title: PO count / spend detail by vendor

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, count(DISTINCT p.id) AS po_count, sum(pi.qty * pi.rate) AS taxable_value, sum(pi.qty * pi.rate * pi.gst_rate / 100.0) AS gst_value FROM pos p JOIN vendors v ON v.id = p.vendor_id JOIN po_items pi ON pi.po_id = p.id GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY taxable_value DESC
